title: Hunga Tonga 2022: The Eruption That Touched Space
core_question: How did a submarine volcano in Tonga produce the tallest eruption plume and the largest atmospheric explosion ever measured by instruments?
why_they_click: Its pressure wave circled the planet several times and every barometer on Earth recorded it, which makes this the most filmed and best instrumented eruption in history.
data_source: NASA Earth Observatory; Smithsonian Global Volcanism Program; NOAA
evidence: 'supervolcano' is rising +36% over five years, and satellite imagery of the blast gives the channel footage no reconstruction can match.
